subject: Planned sunset & migration pathway for bundled Marketplace offer (AWS + GCP)
messages:
From: Sarah Klein <sarah@acme-platform.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@aws-partners.com>, partners@gcp-marketplace.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sunset plan for our bundled listing + ask on migration timeline

Hi Vivek / team,

Quick context: we're sunsetting the legacy "Acme + Redwood Bundle" SKU at the end of Q3 (internal decision to consolidate SKUs). We need a migration path for existing customers who bought via AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace so billing/entitlements continue without disruption.

Asks:
- Can Redwood accept mapped entitlements on your Dedicated offer for customers who migrate?
- What's the minimum lead time we should provide customers for entitlement reconciliation?
- Any co-sell or marketplace partner approvals required on your side?

I've attached a proposed migration matrix (bundle_migration_matrix.xlsx) showing current SKUs, proposed new SKUs, and estimate of monthly seat counts.

Target timeline from Acme: announce July 1, open migration window July 15–Sept 30, final cutover Oct 1. Is that feasible?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call this week.

—Sarah
Sarah Klein
Head of Partnerships, Acme Platform
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah@acme-platform.com>
Cc: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@aws-partners.com>, partners@gcp-marketplace.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sunset plan for our bundled listing + ask on migration timeline

Sarah — thanks for the clear matrix and timeline. Quick answers up front:
- We can support entitlement mapping for migrated customers (we've done this for two partners last year), but we need a canonical mapping table and a signed MSA amendment for billing continuity.
- Minimum lead time: operationally, we recommend ~6 weeks for entitlement validation across marketplaces (we'll need marketplace reports, customer account IDs, and purchase tokens). For custom enterprise customers we usually budget 8–12 weeks.
- Co-sell approvals: if Acme wants continued co-sell attribution post-migration, we'll need to register the new SKU(s) in each marketplace and request co-sell tagging from AWS/GCP — that process takes 2–4 weeks after submission.

Next steps I propose:
1) Redwood and Acme finalize the mapping spreadsheet and delivery of marketplace purchase reports by June 21.
2) Redwood publishes the SKU registration request to AWS/GCP by June 25 (we'll share the publisher form).
3) Joint customer communications draft by June 30 (we'll iterate on your draft).

I've attached the initial notes we use internally for marketplace transitions (aws_seller_central_transition_notes.pdf). Olga / Ben — can you own the mapping review and co-sell registration respectively?

Happy to take a short sync with Marketplace Ops this week if that helps.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
From: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sarah Klein <sarah@acme-platform.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sunset plan for our bundled listing + ask on migration timeline

Thanks Vivek / Sarah — I've reviewed the migration matrix and added comments in column H for entitlement edge-cases (licenses purchased via 3rd-party resellers, subscriptions with committed usage, trial conversions). Main operational notes:
- For AWS Marketplace: we need the customer purchase IDs and the Metering Records export. For listings with SaaS Subscriptions, tokenized entitlement reconciliation is straightforward; for private offers we need the PO numbers.
- For GCP: partner reports are slower — expect 10 business days turnaround for the first reconciliation batch.

Action items I can take:
- Validate mapping for the 25 top customers (by ARR) by June 18.
- Produce an exceptions list (customers requiring manual PO or reseller reconciliation) by June 21.

Sarah — can Acme deliver the purchase-id export and customer account mapping by June 15? That unlocks everything else.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Sarah Klein <sarah@acme-platform.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, marketplace-ops@aws-partners.com, partners@gcp-marketplace.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 15:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sunset plan for our bundled listing + ask on migration timeline

Quick update after a call with Marketplace Ops:
- AWS co-sell tagging: we'll need the SKU registration + co-sell form submitted together. Expect approval / tagging in ~3 weeks after submission if there are no compliance flags.
- GCP: quota and entitlement mapping requests require a partner support ticket per customer for private offers — plan for manual steps on ~10% of accounts.

Roadmap summary (for Acme):
- June 15: Acme delivers purchase-id export + account mapping (owner: Acme)
- June 18: Redwood validates top-25 customers (owner: Olga)
- June 21: Exceptions list + finalize mapping (owner: Olga + Acme)
- June 25: Redwood submits SKU registration + co-sell request to AWS/GCP (owner: Ben)
- June 30: Finalize joint customer comms and publish announcement (owner: Acme + Redwood comms)

If everyone agrees, I'll open the marketplace submission packets on June 25 and keep both partner ops threads copied. Also attaching a one-page customer communication draft (customer_communication_draft.md) for feedback.

Please reply with any blockers. No blockers from my side today.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
